item.name: Transparent Zipper Nylon Pencil Bag Mesh Pen Case Student Stationery Large-Capacity Storage Bag
item.title: Transparent Zipper Nylon Pencil Bag Mesh Pen Case Student Stationery Large-Capacity Storage Bag
item.description:
Keep your stationery neat and stress-free with this transparent zipper nylon pencil bag. With a practical mesh design and a roomy 3D structure, it helps you stay organized for school, study sessions, and everyday carry—so you can grab what you need quickly and move with confidence.

Key Features 
- Transparent mesh design: See what’s inside at a glance for faster access and a cleaner look
- Zipper closure: Securely keeps your pens and stationery in place
- 3D mesh pencil bag style: Roomy shape helps hold more items comfortably
- Large-capacity storage: Designed for everyday student stationery needs

Size and Color Options 
- Size: 20*5*5cm
- Color options: grey, khaki, green, blue, pink

Notes
- Actual color may vary slightly due to light and screen settings
- Please allow slight dimension differences due to manual measurement
